// AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED: imported vars from saved link.
var CONVERT_TO_IMPORT = (
[{"type":"table","name":"studyArea","record":{"id":"projects/ee-rohma/assets/Multan"}}])

// AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED: location from saved link.
Map.setCenter(71.40298244874873, 29.938641701568496, 7)

// var studyArea = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([71.0, 29.5, 75.5, 32.5]);
Map.centerObject(studyArea,7);

var s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
.filterBounds(studyArea)
.filterDate("2025-01-01","2025-12-30")
.filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20));

print("Image Count",s2.size());

var image =s2.median().select(['B4','B3','B2']);
var clipimg=image.clip(studyArea);

Map.addLayer(clipimg,{min:0,max:3000},"True Color");


var addNDVI= function(image){
  var ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4'])
  .rename("NDVI")
  return image.addBands(ndvi)
};

var s2ndvi = s2.map(addNDVI);

var months= ee.List.sequence(1,12);
var monthlyNDVI=ee.ImageCollection.fromImages(
  months.map(function(m){
    return s2ndvi
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(m,m,'month'))
    .select("NDVI")
    .median()
    .set("month",m)
    
  })
  );

var ndviVis={min:-0.1,max:0.8,
palette:['#d73027','#fc8d59','#fee090',
            '#91cf60','#1a9850']};
            
Map.addLayer(
  s2ndvi.select("NDVI").median().clip(studyArea),
  ndviVis,"Annual NDVI"
  );
print('monthly composites',monthlyNDVI.size());



// 1. Define a sample farm point (adjust to your study area)
var farmPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(studyArea);

// 2. Build time-series chart
var chart = ui.Chart.image.series({
  imageCollection: s2ndvi.select('NDVI'),
  region: studyArea,
  reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
  scale: 500,
  xProperty: 'system:time_start'
})
.setOptions({
  title: 'Monthly mean NDVI — Punjab croplands 2025',
  vAxis: {title: 'NDVI', minValue: 0, maxValue: 0.9},
  hAxis: {title: 'Month'},
  lineWidth: 2,
  pointSize: 4,
  colors: ['#1a9850']
});

// 3. Print chart to Console
print(chart);


// Annual NDVI median clipped to study area
var annualNDVI = s2ndvi.select('NDVI')
  .median()
  .clip(studyArea);

// Export to Google Drive
Export.image.toDrive({
  image: annualNDVI,
  description: 'Punjab_NDVI_2024_Annual',
  folder: 'GEE_Exports',
  fileNamePrefix: 'Punjab_NDVI_2024',
  region: studyArea,
  scale: 10,
  crs: 'EPSG:4326',
  maxPixels: 1e13
});

// Also export a classified version (4 classes)
var classified = annualNDVI
  .where(annualNDVI.lt(0.1), 1)   // bare/water
  .where(annualNDVI.gte(0.1).and(annualNDVI.lt(0.3)), 2)  // sparse
  .where(annualNDVI.gte(0.3).and(annualNDVI.lt(0.6)), 3)  // moderate
  .where(annualNDVI.gte(0.6), 4); // dense/healthy

Export.image.toDrive({
  image: classified,
  description: 'Punjab_NDVI_Classified_2024',
  folder: 'GEE_Exports',
  fileNamePrefix: 'Punjab_NDVI_Classified',
  region: studyArea,
  scale: 10,
  crs: 'EPSG:4326',
  maxPixels: 1e13
});
